title: Tracker: stats, 17-week grid, heat levels, streak, selected-day panel
description:
Spec: design/workout-tracker/README.md '3. Tracker' and 'Interactions & Behaviour' (Tracker rule, Streak). Prototype: 178-229; tracker() 719-762.
Stats row (DAY STREAK, month days, TOTAL DAYS). Contribution grid: 17 weeks x 7 days, Mon-Sun rows, month labels, future days ringed and not tappable, selected-day double ring, legend. Heat by sets that day: 1-5 -> 1, 6-9 -> 2, 10+ -> 3, manual-only -> 2. Selected day panel with unified entry cards in order: recorded, live, manual. Live workout card opens Home. Empty day card with 'Log a workout'. '+ Log workout' button (sheet is a separate bead).
acceptance_criteria: Per-day map, heat level, streak (ends today, or yesterday if today is not logged), month count and total days are pure functions with unit tests, including: day lights up after the first saved set of a live workout, manual-only day, streak across a month boundary, week starting Monday. Future days not tappable. States: today with entries, day with manual entries, empty day. Screenshots: tracker, tracker-manual-day, tracker-empty-day. Goldens in dark and light for each state listed, compared with the named screenshots by design-reviewer. Definition of done in AGENTS.md is met.

title: Home: header, workout block, glass Current/Previous toggle

Shared pieces for later beads: ActionButton, OuterShadow, GlassRim, appGlassSettings, clockProvider, workoutTotals/setsVolume, formatVolume, test/helpers/fakes.dart. Theme text styles now carry Geist's 1.3 line height. Not done here: active exercise card and completed rows (fit-epic.5), Add exercise/Add set sheets (fit-epic.6), End workout sheet (fit-epic.7), Previous tab (fit-epic.10), unread dot state (fit-epic.14). title: Supabase migration: title, location, set timestamps, manual workouts
description:
Spec: design/workout-tracker/README.md 'State / Data model'. Mapping and constraints: dev/architecture.md 'How the redesign's model maps onto the schema'.
Add a new timestamped migration in supabase/migrations: workouts.title, workouts.location_type (Gym|Home|Park|Other, check constraint), nullable place_name/place_address/place_lat/place_lng, exercise_sets.created_at (default now(), drives the rest timer), and a manual_workouts table (id, user_id, date as a calendar date, title, location_type, place columns; many rows per date) with RLS and grants matching the existing tables. Existing rows must stay valid.
Update the Dart models and row mappers (Workout, ExerciseSet, new ManualWorkout, LocationType, Place) and the notifiers that select these columns. ExerciseSet weight/reps become double/int.
Do NOT apply the migration to the hosted project. Say in the PR that it adds a migration.
acceptance_criteria: Migration is a new file; no applied migration is edited. Every new table has RLS enabled, anon has no access, and policies restrict rows to auth.uid(). Mapper tests cover the new fields, null place, legacy rows with no title or location, and manual workouts. Existing tests still pass, including workout recovery. PR description states the migration. Definition of done in AGENTS.md is met.
notes: Migration applied to the hosted project (workout_tracker_new) on 2026-10-06 after a rolled-back dry run. The hosted history recorded it as version 20261006232241, so the repo file was renamed from 20261007090000 to match.
close_reason: Added migration 20261007090000 (workouts title/location_type/place_*, exercise_sets.created_at, manual_workouts with RLS). Not applied to the hosted project and not run against a database locally. New models: LocationType, Place, ManualWorkout; Workout moved to lib/models/workout.dart with displayTitle/displayLocationType fallbacks; ExerciseSet is now double weight, int reps, DateTime? savedAt. Mappers: lib/data/location_mapper.dart, lib/data/manual_workout_mapper.dart. Left for later beads: addSetToCurrentExercise still takes strings (fit-epic.6), endWorkout does not write title/location yet (fit-epic.7), no manual workouts notifier yet (fit-epic.12).

title: App shell: glass tab bar, floating action slot, bottom sheet scaffold
description:
Spec: design/workout-tracker/README.md 'Global chrome' and 'Platform notes'. Prototype: tab bar 365-374, action row 349-363, sheet scaffold 376-379.
Replace the NavigationBar in lib/main_bottom_navigation.dart with the floating glass tab bar: 340x66, bottom 26, four tabs (Home, Tracker, Notifications, Profile), sliding 82x52 bubble with the springy 500ms curve, unread dot on the bell. Hidden on Welcome and Summary.
Glass comes from the liquid_glass_widgets package on iOS and Android (dev/decisions.md 15), pinned to an exact version. Read the liquid-glass-widgets skill first. In lib/main.dart call LiquidGlassWidgets.initialize() and wrap the app with LiquidGlassWidgets.wrap(brightnessResolver: Theme.maybeBrightnessOf, ...) so glass follows the app theme. No hand-written BackdropFilter fallback.
Start with a spike and record the answers on this bead: (1) can GlassTabBar.bottom and GlassSegmentedControl match the design's geometry, token colours and spring timing? If not, build the layout on the package's lower-level glass surface; design fidelity wins. (2) Does GlassScaffold work with the floating action row, the orbs and plain sheets? Use it for the shell if so. (3) Which render setting is deterministic under flutter test on Linux? Set it in test/helpers/golden.dart.
Add the floating action row slot (bottom 106) and a shared bottom sheet scaffold (top radius 32, grab handle, scrim tap closes, max height 800, scrolls internally). Sheets are plain, not GlassModalSheet. Add the two background orbs. Tracker and Notifications can be placeholder screens.
acceptance_criteria: Four tabs switch screens; bubble animates. Glass renders through liquid_glass_widgets on iOS and Android, imported only from its public entry point, with an exact version pin. Spike answers are recorded on the bead. Sheet scaffold is a shared widget with a widget test for scrim-tap close. States: tab bar on each of the four tabs. Screenshots: tab bar region of home-idle, tracker, notifications, profile. Goldens in dark and light for each state listed, compared with the named screenshots by design-reviewer. Definition of done in AGENTS.md is met.
notes:
SPIKE ANSWERS (liquid_glass_widgets 1.10.0). (1) GlassTabBar.bottom matches the design geometry through its parameters: barHeight 66, barBorderRadius 33, tabPadding 6, indicatorBorderRadius 26, iconSize 22, 10px labels, token colours, glass settings; in a 340-wide box each tab is 82 wide. Bubble motion is the package's own spring, not the design's 500ms cubic-bezier; check on a device. GlassSegmentedControl exposes the equivalent parameters (height, borderRadius, indicatorBorderRadius, padding, colours, settings) but has not been tried yet: fit-epic.4. (2) GlassScaffold is not used and was not tried: the bar is fixed-size at bottom 26 with the floating action row above it, which a Stack handles (see dev/architecture.md). (3) Under flutter test the package detects FLUTTER_TEST and draws a simplified surface without shaders; no quality setting is needed in the golden harness. STATE: code and tests done on branch fit-epic.3-app-shell. LEFT: commit Linux goldens from CI (test/widgets/goldens/app_shell_*, app_bottom_sheet_*), run design-reviewer on them, then close. Real glass not yet seen on a device.
DESIGN REVIEW (2026-10-07) fixed: tab bar shadow no longer paints behind the glass; Material 3 letter spacing/line height removed from the text theme (lib/theme/app_theme.dart); iPhone keeps bottom 26 / 106 and only Android lifts for a tall navigation bar; golden harness pre-warms the standard glass shader so the first golden matches the rest (LiquidGlassWidgets.initialize() cannot be used in tests: premium shaders are missing). NOT fixed, listed in the PR: bubble is ~82x57 inset 4 instead of 82x52 inset 7 because GlassTabBar.bottom hard-codes the indicator inset; glassLine/glassHi/glassLo rim tokens are not applied (package draws its own rim); a nearby floating button tints the top of the bar through the blur. All three need a look on a device. LEFT: commit the re-rendered Linux goldens from the next CI run, then close.
close_reason: AppShell (lib/widgets/app_shell.dart) stacks AppBackground, the current screen, an optional floating action slot (bottom 106) and AppTabBar (bottom 26); MainBottomNavigation has four AppTab tabs with placeholder Tracker and Notifications screens. AppTabBar is GlassTabBar.bottom from liquid_glass_widgets 1.10.0 with Lucide icons and an unread dot (hasUnread, wired to false until fit-epic.14). showAppSheet/AppSheet in lib/widgets/app_bottom_sheet.dart is the shared sheet. Golden harness now loads the Lucide font, draws real shadows and pre-warms the glass shader. The text theme no longer carries Material 3 letter spacing. Spike answers and review outcome are in the notes. Open and needing a device: bubble is ~82x57 inset 4 (package fixes the inset; design is 82x52 inset 7), rim tokens not applied, floating button tints the bar through the blur, bubble spring is the package's. Home must pass its floating actions through MainBottomNavigation's slot (fit-epic.4).

title: Hold to discard on the End workout button
description:
Spec: design/workout-tracker/README.md 'Hold to discard (End workout button)'. Prototype: holdDown/holdUp 848-849, markup 461-464.
Press and hold works even with no name. After 250ms a black 32% band fills left to right over 3s; label becomes 'Keep holding to discard · 3s/2s/1s', the hint hides, button goes to full opacity. At 3s the workout is discarded (nothing saved, tracker unchanged), the sheet closes and Home is idle. Releasing early resets and does nothing; a hold never also counts as a tap. AnimationController(3s), medium haptic at start, heavy haptic on discard.
acceptance_criteria: Widget tests with fake time: release before 3s does nothing and does not save; hold to 3s discards and deletes the workout row; a hold is never treated as a tap; works with an empty name. Golden of the mid-hold state in both themes (no reference screenshot exists; follow the README). Definition of done in AGENTS.md is met.

title: Place search with OpenStreetMap and current location
description:
Spec: design/workout-tracker/README.md 'Platform notes' (map/place search) and 'Location section'. Decision: dev/decisions.md 16.
Implement the PlaceSearchService interface from the End workout bead with OpenStreetMap data, in one class so it can be replaced: Photon for typed search (debounced, biased to the user's position when known) and Overpass for the NEARBY list (gyms, sports centres and parks within a radius, sorted by distance). Do not use Nominatim for typing. Base URLs are constants in that one file; requests time out and fall back to the 'No results' state.
'Use current location' via geolocator. Request location permission only when the user taps it. NEARBY and distances appear only once a position is known; before that the panel shows the current-location row and typed RESULTS.
Show '© OpenStreetMap contributors' in the search panel (the design has no slot for it; this is a required deviation). Move http from dev_dependencies to dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: OSM implementation sits behind PlaceSearchService and is supplied by a provider; swapping it needs no UI change. Parsing of Photon and Overpass responses is unit-tested with recorded JSON via MockClient. Fake implementation still used in widget tests. Permission requested only on tap; denial is handled without a crash. OpenStreetMap attribution is visible in the search panel. iOS and Android permission strings added (this touches ios/ and android/ config: call it out in the PR). Definition of done in AGENTS.md is met.

title: Notifications screen
description:
Spec: design/workout-tracker/README.md '6. Notifications'. Prototype: 306-322. Decision: dev/decisions.md 17.
Title and a list of cards: unread dot, title, time, body. Opening the tab marks all read and clears the bell dots on the tab bar and Home header. There is no notifications backend: the data sits behind a provider that returns no items, and the app shows an empty state. Do not ship placeholder content. The card layout is still built and tested with fixture data so a real source can be plugged in later.
